question: Development of a country can generally be determined by (i) its per capita income (ii) its average literacy level (iii) health status of its people (iv) all the above
options: Answer: (iv) all the above. Holistic development includes economic growth alongside human capital indicators.
explanation: Answer: (iv) all the above. Holistic development includes economic growth alongside human capital indicators.

question: Which international organization publishes the Human Development Report?
Why is per capita income considered an inadequate metric for comparing national development?
options: Per capita income hides income disparities across citizens, ignores essential public goods (healthcare, safety, clean en
explanation: Per capita income hides income disparities across citizens, ignores essential public goods (healthcare, safety, clean environment), and fails to measure literacy or life expectancy. Key points: Hides income distribution/disparities; Ignores health and education indicators; Excludes non-material factors

question: Passage Context: ''The Earth has enough resources to meet the needs of all but not enough to satisfy the greed of even one person.' - Mahatma Gandhi' - How is this statement relevant to the discussion of development?
options: It underlines the necessity of sustainable resource utilization, warning against over-exploitation of natural assets lik
explanation: It underlines the necessity of sustainable resource utilization, warning against over-exploitation of natural assets like groundwater and fossil fuels for short-term profits.

question: Explain the concept of Sustainable Development. Illustrate with examples of resource depletion in India.
options: Sustainable development refers to development that meets present needs without compromising future generations' ability
explanation: Sustainable development refers to development that meets present needs without compromising future generations' ability to meet theirs. In India, groundwater over-exploitation (1/3 of districts pumping beyond recharge rates in Punjab/Western UP) and global crude oil depletion highlight the urgent need for renewable transition and regulatory enforcement.
